text: This report presents the revised 2026 annual objectives for the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO for the review and approval of the Board of Directors, CreateTO. The CreateTO - Human Resources Committee considered a draft list of 2026 annual objectives at their February 20, 2026 meeting. The Committee referred the item to staff with direction to report directly to the March 6, 2026 Board meeting with revised 2026 annual objectives that reflect the feedback received from the Committee.
The Board of Directors, CreateTO referred Item RA24.5, headed Revised 2026 Annual Objectives - Chief Executive Officer, to the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee for further consideration.
